The preference for better-corroborated theories (SRC_003) depends on the pragmatic decision rule that maximizes error elimination potential without assuming future uniformity. Refuted If: The preference logically entails a premise that the future will resemble the past, or if acting on the theory requires believing it is likely true, thereby collapsing the distinction between corroboration and induction.
